# GitHub Copilot Instructions

`AGENTS.md` in the repository root is the mandatory canonical instruction entry point for all coding, review, refactoring, architecture, UI/UX, security, accessibility, i18n/l10n, and testing work in this repository.

Before changing or reviewing code:

1. Read `AGENTS.md` completely.
2. Follow the mandatory detailed standards referenced from `AGENTS.md`.
3. Read the current version of every existing file before modifying it.
4. Reuse existing architecture, components, design tokens, i18n resources, and test patterns before introducing new ones.
5. Do not create parallel or conflicting coding rules in this file.

If the required repository instructions cannot be loaded, do not modify the repository.
